title: Math: Mixed Practical Word Problems I

questions.text: If 6 shirts and 5 pants cost $120, and 5 shirts and 5 pants cost $90, how much does 1 shirt cost?
A cyclist travels at 15 km/h for 2 hours, then rests for 30 minutes, and finishes 10 km in 30 minutes. What was the average cycling speed (excluding rest)?
questions.explanation: Total cycling distance = (15 * 2) + 10 = 40 km. Total cycling time = 2h + 0.5h = 2.5h. Average speed = 40 / 2.5 = 16 km/h.

questions.text: In a class of 40 students, 25 play football, 20 play basketball, and 8 play neither. How many students play both sports?
questions.explanation: Students playing at least one sport = 40 - 8 = 32. Both = (25 + 20) - 32 = 13.
